title: Mala House | KEY.co
description_expanded: The residence's splendor continues on the second floor, where the master suite offers a private sanctuary equipped with a walk-in shower and a soothing soaking tub. Additional accommodations include a stylish bedroom with a king-size bed and a bunk room perfect for younger guests or extra company, both sharing access to a well-appointed bathroom. This floor also hosts a convenient laundry room. Ascend to the third floor—the home's vibrant heart—where a gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances and extensive marble countertops awaits. This floor also features a chic dining area and a cozy living room, ideal for gathering and feasting with loved ones. The crowning jewel is the private pool on the third-floor balcony, offering panoramic views of pristine, white sandy beaches, ensuring every moment is draped in scenic luxury. Mala House was awesome! It was perfect for our family vacation with our adult kids and grand baby! We were able to give our son, daughter in law & granddaughter the first floor. They had plenty of room to spread out. It had a small fridge down there for baby bottles. Having 3 king bedrooms each with its own full bath was great! The pool with the ocean and sunset view was our favorite thing about the house! So nice! We had everything we needed in the kitchen. The public beach was a very short walk & not too crowded. Lots of restaurants and shopping nearby. We liked this area better than Seaside! Restaurants we loved were Fonville Press for breakfast/brunch. Shades & Old Florida Fish House dinner. Pickles at seaside for a meal on the beach patio with an amazing view. Mala was our favorite house we’ve rented so we will be back!
